label: Morning Brief
periodStart: Fri, Oct 30, 2026, 4:00 PM ET (previous close; weekend rolled up)
timezoneNote: All times shown in ET (America/New_York). Reuters was read through a MarketScreener republication.

driver.text: Per Reuters, US index futures rose at 8:06 AM ET after the Nasdaq-100 lost over $2.5 trillion in October on concerns about Big Tech AI spending and debt financing. Alphabet was among the top premarket gainers. Intel was down about 1% after its worst one-day fall since the 1980s on Friday. Oil fell more than 4% on hopes of a deal to end the US-Israeli war on Iran. Midterm elections are Tuesday.
